text:
maria: heads-up — been thinking about the auto-fallback/rollback flow. if we let it auto-rollback model variants on spikes, how do we avoid oscillations and noisy churn?
kevin: +1. we need both rate limits and a cooldown. e.g. only allow 1 auto-rollback per pool per 30m and require the trigger to be sustained (n/ m windows)
sam: agree. also UI-wise we should surface the rollback impact before applying (preview % traffic rerouted, estimated latency delta). operators should be able to ‘simulate’ rollback.
ops-bot: alert: [AUTO-ROLLBACK] policy=my-fallback-pol triggered on service=redwood-gen, error_rate=3.4% window=2m decision_id=rb-20260321-001 :eyes:
jen: for the policy DSL, can we add explicit quotas like `max_rollbacks_per_hour` and `cooldown`? otherwise a noisy upstream could force many rollbacks.
maria: prototype policy snippet i sketched:
```json
{"trigger":"5xx_rate>2%","window":"2m","sustain_n_of_m":"3/4","cooldown":"10m","max_rollbacks_per_hour":"1","sampling_rate":"0.1"}
```
kevin: nice. add `require_manual_if_impact_gt` (percent) — e.g. if rollback would switch >20% traffic, require manual confirm. prevents mass flips.
rachel: telemetry: every rollback decision needs a `decision_id` shipped with traces and metrics so we can join logs -> rollback event. also include `reason`, `policy_version`, and the evaluated signal snapshot.
sam: audit & exports: UI should let you export rollback history (CSV/JSON) with timestamps, decision_id, who/what invoked it (auto vs manual), sample request ids. we should also support paginated playback for forensic debugging.
maria: ops question — sampling: do we sample the requests used for the decision or attach the decision_id to all requests for X minutes? sampling reduces costs but makes forensic harder.
kevin: compromise: attach decision_id to all requests for 2m after a decision, and sample deeper traces (10%) afterwards. plus a audit-sample bucket that stores full payloads for a rolling 24h.
jen: UI knobs to add: default cooldown (10m), max rollbacks/hour (1), preview simulate button, `require_manual_if_impact_gt` slider, sampling percent. sensible defaults and tooltips.
maria: action items: (1) eng-platform: add policy fields + validation (kevin), (2) telemetry: emit rollback.{requested,executed,reverted} with decision_id and policy_version (rachel), (3) console: preview + export + manual confirm flow (sam/jen). i'll write a short RFC tomorrow and prototype the policy form. thanks all :thumbsup:
ops-bot: note: playbook reminder — add a runbook entry for investigating rollback oscillations (assigned: maria).
